preconditions.description: The length of the expression E is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: 0 <= P and 0 <= M and P + M == E.count('?')
preconditions.description: The number of plus and minus operators P and M are non-negative and their sum equals the number of '?' in E.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible value of the expression after replacing '?' with '+' and '-' operators.
